menu:3133760:1.text: Where are we supposed to find lizard eggs now?!
menu:3133760:1.source_cn: 现在要上哪去找蜥蜴蛋啊！

menu:3133760:2.text: If only we had some special spices!
menu:3133760:2.source_cn: 要是能有点特殊香料就好了！

say:1:1123632001:1.text: Lately, several warriors have successfully passed their trials. We're preparing a feast to celebrate the occasion.
say:1:1123632001:1.source_cn: 最近一段时间，有几位战士通过了正式的试炼。为了庆祝，我...

say:2:1123632002:1.text: However, our supply of <style="highlight">sandbeast meat</style> is running low. We're also understaffed at the moment. We need your help.
say:2:1123632002:1.male: However, our supply of <style="highlight">sandbeast meat</style> is running low. We're also understaffed at the moment. We need your help.
say:2:1123632002:1.female: However, our supply of <style="highlight">sandbeast meat</style> is running low. We're also understaffed at the moment. We need your help.

say:3:1123632003:1.text: When you've prepared enough sandbeast meat, give it to the chef. Also, can you ask him whether he needs help with anything?
say:3:1123632003:1.source_cn: 等你准备好野猪肉，就交给大厨吧，顺便看看他是否还需要什...
say:3:1123632003:1.male: When you've prepared enough sandbeast meat, give it to the chef. Also, can you ask him whether he needs help with anything?
say:3:1123632003:1.female: When you've prepared enough sandbeast meat, give it to the chef. Also, can you ask him whether he needs help with anything?

say:0:1123633001:0.text: Chippy remembers that there were sandbeasts where we bumped into Alsa.
say:0:1123633001:0.source_cn: 满满记得，我们遇到阿尔萨的地方就有很多野猪。

say:1:1123633002:0.text: If those dangerous sandbeasts were gone, travelers wouldn't have to be worried about the road!
say:1:1123633002:0.source_cn: 而且那些野猪都很凶！清除它们之后，过路人也不用担心受到...

say:0:1123634001:0.text: We've got enough. Let's go see the chef.
say:0:1123634001:0.source_cn: 这些野猪肉足够了，拿去交给大厨吧。
say:0:1123634001:0.male: We've got enough. Let's go see the chef.
say:0:1123634001:0.female: We've got enough. Let's go see the chef.

say:1:1123635001:1.text: That's a lot of sandbeast meat! Impressive!
say:1:1123635001:1.source_cn: 你居然带来了这么多野猪肉！真是厉害啊！
say:1:1123635001:1.male: That's a lot of sandbeast meat! Impressive!
say:1:1123635001:1.female: That's a lot of sandbeast meat! Impressive!

say:2:1123635002:1.source_cn: 刚好，还有另一件事想请你帮忙！

say:3:1123635003:1.text: My egg-laying <style="highlight">lizard</style> is missing. Could you help me find her? I planned today's feast because she's going to lay some today. I really need those eggs for my dishes.
say:3:1123635003:1.male: My egg-laying <style="highlight">lizard</style> is missing. Could you help me find her? I planned today's feast because she's going to lay some today. I really need those eggs for my dishes.
say:3:1123635003:1.female: My egg-laying <style="highlight">lizard</style> is missing. Could you help me find her? I planned today's feast because she's going to lay some today. I really need those eggs for my dishes.

say:0:1123636001:0.text: You found my lizard! Now I just need her to lay her eggs!
say:0:1123636001:0.source_cn: 总算找回来了。等蜥蜴下完蛋，食材也就齐了！

say:1:1123636002:0.text: There's also a <style="highlight">merchant who sells a special spice</style> near Sunseek Arena. I need that spice.
say:1:1123636002:0.source_cn: 对了，残阳武斗场附近有个<style=highligh...
say:1:1123636002:0.male: There's also a <style="highlight">merchant who sells a special spice</style> near Sunseek Arena. I need that spice.
say:1:1123636002:0.female: There's also a <style="highlight">merchant who sells a special spice</style> near Sunseek Arena. I need that spice.

say:0:1123637001:0.text: Apologies, you came at a bad time. The spice is sold out.
say:0:1123637001:0.source_cn: 抱歉，您来得不巧，我的独家香料早就卖光了。
say:0:1123637001:0.male: Apologies, you came at a bad time. The spice is sold out.
say:0:1123637001:0.female: Apologies, you came at a bad time. The spice is sold out.

say:1:1123637002:0.text: To make more, I need <style="highlight">golden sandstone nuts</style> from these herbs.
say:1:1123637002:0.source_cn: 要重新制作的话，需要从这些香草里挑出<style=hi...

say:2:1123637003:0.text: If you give me a hand, I can give you a pack of the spice for free!
say:2:1123637003:0.source_cn: 如果您不介意的话，倒是可以帮我挑一下。我可以免费送您一...
say:2:1123637003:0.male: If you give me a hand, I can give you a pack of the spice for free!
say:2:1123637003:0.female: If you give me a hand, I can give you a pack of the spice for free!

say:1:1123638002:0.text: Here's the spice you wanted! Use it well!
say:1:1123638002:0.source_cn: 既然如此，那我就免费送您一包我的独家香料！一定要好好使...
say:1:1123638002:0.male: Here's the spice you wanted! Use it well!
say:1:1123638002:0.female: Here's the spice you wanted! Use it well!

say:1:1123639001:1.text: Yes! With this spice, the meat will taste amazing!
say:1:1123639001:1.source_cn: 嗬！果然还是得用这种香料，烤肉的味道才最好！

say:2:1123639002:1.text: You've been such a big help today. Why don't you stay and enjoy the feast with us? You have to try my cooking!
say:2:1123639002:1.source_cn: 你帮了我这么多忙，今天也留下来和我们一起享用这顿大餐吧...
say:2:1123639002:1.male: You've been such a big help today. Why don't you stay and enjoy the feast with us? You have to try my cooking!
say:2:1123639002:1.female: You've been such a big help today. Why don't you stay and enjoy the feast with us? You have to try my cooking!

narration:3:1123639003:1.text: The feast continues late into the night. Barbecuing has become an art for the Grimmaw Clan.
